prompt: Single continuous shot. Opens mid-action: a thick medallion lowered into a ripping-hot pan — a violent sear roar, crust forming instantly, flame licking the edge. Flipped once to reveal a deep mahogany crust. The camera holds as wine pours into the emptied pan, igniting a brief dramatic flare, then reducing into a dark glossy syrup with mushrooms sliding through it. Money shot: the medallion sliced to reveal a perfect rosy center in macro, then the madeira sauce poured slowly over the slices, sheeting down the sides and pooling, steam backlit. Final beat: the plate finished, sauce spoon resting. Warm intimate light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the sear roar, then the flambé whoosh. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
